aggregation.lane: source_origin_index modulo horizon; mature same-lane forecast before next issuance

optimizer.selection: smallest achieved feasible objective; numerical convex lower bound for transformed fit only

selection.criterion: minimum equal-contract mean validation FZ0 among these five transformed candidates

comparison.estimator: common origin dates, equal arithmetic mean of eight contract FZ0 differences; negative is better

bootstrap.type: paired fixed-length circular origin-date blocks, shared across all contracts and comparators

comparison.success: all four one-sided 95% percentile upper limits strictly below zero at BOTH block lengths
comparison.multiplicity: conjunctive intersection-union claim only; no subset cherry-picking
comparison.interpretation: approximate dependent historical resampling diagnostic; not finite-sample validity under arbitrary nonstationarity

design_history: Method family, old assets and dates had already been examined in preceding research. This primary was chosen using only the old four currencies through 2019. An earlier design-only replay with about-2000 weight warmup was retained but superseded by the common 2010-start rule before new-asset evaluation. No AUD/CAD/NOK/SEK outcomes were inspected or evaluated before this file was frozen. Their header availability alone was checked. New-asset test dates overlap prior market dates and share a correlated current-vintage ECB source; this is asset transfer, not independent external or prospective temporal replication.
reporting: retain every model, contract, comparator and secondary window; four extra matured one-step origins per currency outside common date window are separate; do not retune on test outcomes
